N.promptText: [S1] At two forty-seven in the morning, a number he didn't know sent him a text. Jay was playing The Endless Halls. The game where the tall man only moves when you look away.

lines.text: Every night at nine o'clock, the same player beat Jay in Hyperlane.
lines.cap: Every night at *9:00,* the same player beat Jay in *Hyperlane.*

lines.text: His name was Iron Gramps. Nobody knew who he was.
lines.cap: His name was *IRONGRAMPS.* Nobody knew who he was.

lines.text: Jay practiced every single day after school.
lines.cap: Jay practiced *every single day* after school.

lines.text: And every night at nine, Iron Gramps still won. By inches.
lines.cap: And every night at nine, IronGramps still won. *By inches.*

lines.text: Who do you think Iron Gramps is? Comment it.
lines.cap: Who do you think *IronGramps* is? Comment it.

lines.text: Nice try, kiddo. Eat your vegetables. Bedtime soon.
Then one night, right as Jay lost... someone cheered. Downstairs.
lines.cap: Then one night, right as Jay lost... someone *cheered.* Downstairs.

lines.text: He crept down to see who it was.
lines.cap: He crept down to see *who it was.*

lines.text: Seventy-one years old. Giant headset. Doing a victory dance.
lines.cap: Seventy-one years old. Giant headset. Doing a *victory dance.*

lines.text: He'd been practicing for months... just so Jay would play with him.
lines.cap: He'd been practicing for months... just so Jay would *play with him.*

lines.text: So that night, they raced side by side. And Jay finally won.
lines.cap: So that night, they raced *side by side.* And Jay finally *won.*

lines.text: Did Grandpa let him win? Comment it.
lines.cap: Did Grandpa *let him win?* Comment it.

lines.text: Hyperlane is one of tons of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.
lines.cap: *Hyperlane* is one of *tons* of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.

lines.text: Free at box dot pulseform dot org. Play it on a computer... maybe with your grandpa.
lines.cap: Free at... *box.pulseform.org.* Play it on a *computer...* maybe with your *grandpa.*
